items.text: Are READY and VALID independent? (Does the design ever wait for READY before asserting VALID?)
Are AWID and ARID matched perfectly by the corresponding BID and RID from the slave?
Do transactions with the SAME ID always complete in the exact order they were issued?
Are you correctly verifying that there is NO required ordering between transactions with DIFFERENT IDs?
Does the design guarantee that NO burst ever crosses a 4KB boundary?
Are WLAST and RLAST asserted on the exact beat specified by AxLEN? (Not early, not late?)
Are your scoreboards keyed by ID (and tracking out-of-order returns), rather than by Address?
Are WRAP bursts strictly aligned to their AxSIZE, and are their lengths strictly 2, 4, 8, or 16?
